description: Search Instagram accounts and hashtags by free text (the app's search box). Turn a half-remembered name into a username for the other ig_* tools. For taggable places, use location_search.

instance.description: Optional. Browser instance id from account_info; defaults to the active one.

instant.description: Optional. Skip INSSIST's action pacing and run now — use only when the user asked for an unspaced or burst action.

query.description: What to search for. A leading @ or # is ignored.

type.description: "account" or "hashtag". Omit to search both, which costs two requests.

name: ig_search
title: Instagram search
